My plot is small, only 0.17 hectares, so I must be careful with every kwacha I spend. Last season I got a FISP coupon for one bag of NPK and one bag of urea, and I am hoping for the same this year — without it I cannot afford much fertilizer. I always plant hybrid maize seed because the local seed gives too little, and I intercrop with pigeon pea like my neighbors do to help the soil and have something to eat. I do not have money for pesticide and there is no river close by for irrigation, so I rely on the rains and my own hands.
